note: 钻头(Drill)加油/升级专员,游戏内头衔为 'Drill Mechanic'(见 Mining/GUI_Item/Mithril_Drill_SX-R226.json 里 mithril_drill_sxr226_apply_hint_2 的 gloss,已交叉核实两处一致)。翻译该头衔时需要和物品 Lore 里的说法保持统一。
source_note: Wiki 的手机索要台词仍为 wanted one; 实测为 wanted an Abiphone Basic,两者都保留。ONLY Abiphone 的分段按日志修复。

messages.raw: §fSup, §b%s§f? I am §2Jotraeline Greatforge§f, your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading §aDrills§f.

segments.text: , your one stop shop for refueling and upgrading

segments.zh: 加油和升级,找我一家就够了。

messages.context: 第一次见面,介绍钻头概念
messages.text: Drills are like pickaxes, but better! They are powered with Drill Fuel, which comes in many different forms.
messages.gloss: Drill Fuel 指钻头燃料系统,与 GLOSSARY.md 里 Fuel 词条呼应。
messages.zh: 钻头就像镐子,但更厉害! 它们靠钻头燃料驱动,燃料有很多种形式。

segments.zh: 我只要一台 Abiphone Basic 就行。

messages.raw: §fI heard you have a composter in your barn, it happens to run on the same fuel drills run on! Could I check it out?
messages.text: I heard you have a composter in your barn, it happens to run on the same fuel drills run on! Could I check it out?
messages.zh: 听说你谷仓里有台堆肥机,它烧的燃料正好和钻头一样! 我能去看看吗?

messages.raw: §fQuite fascinating technology you have there, I'm sure with this machinery we could create even better appliances in the future!
messages.text: Quite fascinating technology you have there, I'm sure with this machinery we could create even better appliances in the future!
messages.zh: 你那套技术真是妙极了,我相信有了这种机械,将来我们能造出更好的设备!

messages.raw: §fThat's alright! I'll just save up 12 years to be able to afford one myself.
messages.text: That's alright! I'll just save up 12 years to be able to afford one myself.
messages.zh: 没关系! 我攒个 12 年,自己也买得起一台。

messages.zh: 钻头可带劲了! 可惜你还没有一个。听说可以在锻造炉里打造出来!
